discrepancies.readme_text: Summary: "Correct on a real application ... every probed thread's exit was counted, in every run." What this means 1: "Types 1 and 2 with documented-only correctness work on a real application: exact counts".
discrepancies.data: p1-p4 status files have 3 words (deliveries, FINAL, pid), and FINAL was set by the atexit delivery, which REVIEW.md calls undefined (driver API after main). Every p1-p4 count therefore came through that delivery. In p5/p6 default hist, the in-process deliveries covered only 829/857 of 859 and 9,271/9,341 of 9,749 syncs, so its counts came from the exit delivery. EXIT_DELIVERY = 1 in every item, including the +sync ones, and the exit delivery writes the same shared values after the last in-process delivery. The checked values are thus always the exit delivery's; the in-process (documented) values were never captured on their own. On the victim, f1-hist and d1-hist had 1 delivery (the exit one) with 0 of 3 syncs covered, and f1-latmix covered 1 of 3. 'In every run' is not measured: the checks are on totals per llama-bench invocation (warmup + 5 runs).
discrepancies.correction: "The counts were exact in every item. They were read after exit, from values the best-effort exit delivery (CUDA calls after main) wrote last. For in-call items, and default lat in p5/p6, an in-process delivery had covered the last synchronization, so the same values were documented-complete before exit, but they were not captured separately. In p1-p4 and for default hist, exactness rests on the exit delivery. The checks are on totals per llama-bench invocation (warmup + 5 runs)."

discrepancies.readme_text: "The minimal prototype of the design whose correctness rests on documented guarantees only". Type 1530 row: "local memory is the thread's own storage for the kernel's run (PTX ISA 5.1.5; programming guide 2.3.3)".
discrepancies.data: step0b README claim 6, 'local memory survives preemption', is class P ("preemption not named"); C1 adds "no warp moved, so migration itself was not exercised". Claim 10, relaxed capture mode not invalidating captures, is class P; the delivery runs in relaxed capture mode and is backed by the measured capture stress (0 of 3,000 invalidated). c5-guarantees claim 8: D for the synchronizing thread, P for a reader in another process ("that hop rests on the CPU's memory model, not on a fetched text"); the tool reads the shared values from another process.
discrepancies.correction: "...rests on documented guarantees, except three parts that step0b classed as partly documented: local memory across preemption (preemption is not named), relaxed capture mode not invalidating the application's captures (shown by measurement: the capture stress), and the hand-over from the agent to the reader process (the CPU's memory model)."

It does not show that every probed launch came before it: graph launches are not noted, and pt_exitfast lost 2/3 of its exits with the status reading covered and 0 launches after the last sync. On tg128 completeness rests on the measured counts."
